name: Bromo
hookId: Private trip Bromo: saksikan sunrise dari Penanjakan, jelajahi Lautan Pasir dengan Jeep, dan daki kawah aktif tanpa ribet.
hookEn: Journey into the heart of East Java to experience a breathtaking golden sunrise from Penanjakan, venture across the Sea of Sand, and hike an active volcano.
